literature_reference.citation: T. V. W. Janssens et al., Journal of Catalysis 240 (2006) 108-113

size_activity_relation.primary_citation: S. H. Overbury et al., Journal of Catalysis 241 (2006) 56-65
size_activity_relation.reason_for_nominal: Use the 4.5 wt% Au/TiO2 series because it most closely matches the 4.40 wt% absolute-rate anchor.

geometry.description: First-order geometric scaling of exposed Au fraction with inverse particle diameter, anchored to the measured 38% dispersion at 2.10 nm.

reactor_model.target_definition: Use the conversion implied by the reported stabilized reference activity, catalyst mass and 214.4 Nml/min reaction flow; do not tune conversion manually.

economic_mapping.definition: Relative catalyst procurement burden at fixed catalyst composition and common unit prices; cost ratio equals required catalyst-mass ratio. Reactor packing burden is reported separately and is also proportional to required catalyst mass under fixed powder and tube geometry.
